parsedVerdict.reasoning: TicketController fits the presentation layer. It declares the request body shapes (BuyBody, ScanBody), passes each request to the business services BoxOffice and GateLog, and turns the results into response DTOs, using the presentation helper euros() to format money. It has no persistence, no pricing or seat rules, and no validation of business invariants: purchase totals, admission and remaining seats are all worked out in business code. The scan() method calls admit() and then gates.scanned() in a fixed order. That is light coordination of two business operations, not a business rule held in the controller, though a stricter reading could argue the business layer should own that order.
